prompt: Reassemble one direction of a connection with base sequence number 5000. Segments arrive out of order.
code:
A: seq 5007, 10 bytes
B: seq 5000,  7 bytes
C: seq 5020,  4 bytes

trace.label: Segment A is stored at offset
After A and B, the contiguous stream covers offsets

explain: Offset = seq - base. A covers 7..16 and B covers 0..6, so 0..16 is present. C starts at offset 20, leaving 17, 18 and 19 missing, so the request is incomplete and must be rejected.
